candidate.name: input length
candidate.meaning: The number of bits in each of the two integers being multiplied, which is the length the worst-case time is measured against.
candidate.earlier_meaning: The count of bits in each input of the machine, the length in bits of each input.

candidate.name: power-saving constant
candidate.meaning: A fixed constant greater than 0 that does not depend on $n$.
candidate.earlier_meaning: A fixed constant equal to $2^{-182}$, the same for every input length $n$.

candidate.name: space dimension
candidate.meaning: The dimension of the space E, which counts the basis vectors of E.
candidate.earlier_meaning: The integer numerator of a dyadic rational written as $m/2^k$.

judged.note: Rename the dimension of E (for example to d_E), since m on the dyadic page is an integer numerator.

candidate.name: tail vertex
candidate.meaning: A vertex of the network, a gate or terminal; it is the tail of an edge from x to y.
candidate.earlier_meaning: The value of the first bank, held on one wire.

judged.note: Rename the tail vertex (for example to p), since x is the first bank value on the linear network page.

candidate.name: head vertex
candidate.meaning: A vertex at the head of the edge from x, the vertex the edge enters.
candidate.earlier_meaning: The value of the second bank, held on one wire.

judged.note: Rename the head vertex (for example to q), since y is the second bank value on the linear network page.

candidate.name: smaller call count
candidate.meaning: The total number of smaller calls, which counts the smaller operations over all edges.
candidate.earlier_meaning: The number of edges in a route, so that the route has $s+1$ vertices.

judged.note: Rename the route length (for example to t), since s on the subspace and recursive pages is the total number of smaller calls.

candidate.name: edge rank
candidate.meaning: The rank of one edge matrix, which is summed over all edges to give the total number of smaller calls.
candidate.earlier_meaning: The real part of the Gaussian dyadic number $z$.

judged.note: Rename the edge rank (for example to rk(e)), since a is the real part of a Gaussian dyadic number on the dyadic page.

candidate.name: smaller call count
candidate.meaning: The total number of smaller calls, counted as the sum of the edge ranks over all edges.
candidate.earlier_meaning: The number of edges in a route, so that the route has $s+1$ vertices.

judged.note: Rename the route length (for example to t), since s on the recursive-saving page is the total number of smaller calls.

candidate.name: field width
candidate.meaning: The number of bits in each of the two address fields, their common width.
candidate.earlier_meaning: The first value of an input pair to the butterfly map $H_0$.

judged.note: Rename the field width (for example to w), since u is the first butterfly input on the dyadic page.

candidate.name: field width
candidate.meaning: The number of bits in each of the two address fields, their common width.

judged.note: Rename the field width (for example to w), since u is the tail vertex on the frame page.

candidate.name: stored volume

candidate.name: matrix size

candidate.earlier_meaning: The dimension of the space E, which counts the basis vectors of E.

judged.note: Rename the matrix size (for example to mu), since m is the space dimension on the subspace page.

candidate.name: matrix size
